overview: The commission met to handle licensing business ahead of its summer recess, approving two retail license transfers, two pledges of collateral, and a large slate of special one-day alcohol licenses. Commissioners also advised local businesses on seasonal outdoor dining guidelines and private event regulations.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved meeting minutes from March 15, April 19, and May 17, 2023.

items.title: Anthony's Liquors License Transfer and Pledge
items.summary: Approved the transfer of the package store license for Anthony's Liquors to 269 Spring Street, Inc., along with the appointment of Vimal Patel as manager and a pledge of license and inventory to Rockland Trust Company.

items.title: Medford Wine and Spirits License Transfer
items.summary: Approved the transfer of the all-alcohol package store license from Trident Liquors to Khabib Corp., doing business as Medford Wine and Spirits, and approved Krupal Patel as manager of record.

items.title: Bocelli's Pledge of Collateral
items.summary: Approved the pledge of collateral for Sarah Kim Inc., doing business as Bocelli's, with Chairman Martorana recused due to family ties.

items.title: Boston Glory One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved one-day licenses for Boston Glory home games on June 24 and July 21, 2023, expanding the service area to the stadium's first section of bleachers subject to submission of a layout diagram.

items.title: Medford Brewing Company One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved one-day licenses for Medford Pride on June 25 and two Farmers Market concert dates on July 20 and August 31, 2023, conditioned on receipt of certificates of liability insurance.

items.title: Somerville Boxing Club One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for an August 12, 2023 event at Hormel Stadium, conditioned on hiring a licensed bartender, providing liability insurance, submitting a layout diagram, and coordinating with the police detail desk.

items.title: Tasty Cafe One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a class reunion on June 25, 2023 at Tasty Cafe, restricted to indoor service and conditioned on providing liquor liability insurance.

items.title: Medford Public Library One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved one-day licenses for library events on July 22, August 17, and August 27, 2023, with indoor service and current insurance verification required.

items.title: Event Them Studios One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved five one-day alcohol licenses for private and community events scheduled between July 15 and September 8, 2023.

items.title: Outdoor Dining and Regulatory Inquiries
items.summary: Commissioners confirmed Medford Brewing Company can utilize its patio under seasonal outdoor dining rules pending final state ABCC sign-off, and clarified catering and private event rules with Event Them Studios.
